manifesto.label: 04 · OUR MANIFESTO
manifesto.title: Faced with an obsolete system that judges the past, we are building a future where recruitment is finally based on potential, humanity and intelligence.
manifesto.p1: The current system is in crisis. It fails everyone. Companies are flooded with mismatched profiles while candidates, judged on a résumé that doesn’t reflect their true potential, are treated as an interchangeable resource. This paradox costs billions and breeds immense frustration. We refuse this status quo.
manifesto.p2: Hiry was built on a simple conviction: recruitment shouldn’t be a selection based on the past, but an encounter based on future potential. By replacing keywords with a deep understanding of skills, culture and aspirations, we create authentic connections.
manifesto.mission: 1 Mission · Make recruitment fairer and more human

problem.label: 01 · THE FACTS
problem.title: Your students aren’t adopting your Career Center.
problem.subtitle: It’s normal. Yesterday’s tools no longer meet today’s students’ expectations, nor your institution’s steering requirements.

c1.title: Your Career Center? A directory.
c1.desc: Your students don’t use it, and that’s normal. A static tool where you have to search yourself generates neither engagement nor adoption. Result: an under-used investment.

c2.title: Traditional method = maximum friction
c2.desc: Your students drop out at step one. Writing a résumé, customizing a cover letter… most give up before even applying. Too much friction kills placement.

c3.title: The hidden market stays… hidden
c3.desc: Micro-businesses, SMBs, startups: they make up 99% of companies but never appear on your platforms. Your students miss thousands of opportunities.

c4.title: Zero visibility on what’s really happening
c4.desc: Who applies? Where? When? Why? Today you have no idea. Without real data, you can’t steer placement or prove your results.

vision.label: 04 · OUR VISION FOR SCHOOLS
vision.title: Career placement shouldn’t be an afterthought. We are building a smart bridge between your students and the professional world.
vision.p1: Every student you train deserves support all the way to their first job. The problem isn’t a lack of talent or a lack of openings, it’s the absence of a tool that intelligently connects the two. Traditional Career Centers are static directories nobody uses, and placement data arrives too late to act.
vision.p2: By combining AI with a fine understanding of students’ profiles and potential, Hiry replaces friction with proactive matching. Your students no longer need to search: the opening comes to them. And you finally steer placement with real data, in real time.
vision.mission: 1 Mission · Make every program pay off in placement

pricing.label: SCHOOL PRICING

pricing.desc: Pricing depends on cohort size and the level of support you want. A 30-minute scoping call with the team.

faq.label: 05 · FAQ
faq.title: Your questions? Our answers.
faq.q1: What type of institution can use Hiry?
faq.a1: Business schools, engineering schools, universities, specialized schools, apprentice training centers: as soon as you have cohorts to place (internship, apprenticeship, first job), the control tower adapts to your tracks and programs.
faq.q2: How long to get up and running?
faq.a2: About ten minutes to create your space, 2 minutes to invite a cohort. No IT project, no complex integration: our team supports you for an express start.
faq.q3: How are students matched with companies?
faq.a3: Each student creates an enriched profile with Hiron, our AI: soft skills, aspirations and potential beyond the résumé. Matching then automatically connects each profile to compatible openings from your network and the Hiry pool, with a transparent score.
faq.q4: How does Hiry detect struggling students?
faq.a4: The dashboard monitors weak signals: engagement drop, inactivity, matches with no follow-up. The AI predicts placement risk per profile and proactively alerts you, so you can act before it’s too late.
faq.q5: Can we export data for our accreditations?
faq.a5: Yes: placement funnel, benchmark by cohort and program, event outcomes: everything exports as presentation-ready reports for your accreditations, rankings and boards.
faq.q6: What does it cost the school?
faq.a6: Custom quote, based on cohort size and desired support level. The solution remains free of charge for your students, in all cases.
